content:
A photo from a walk on 2026-03-21.  
📷 OM-3 & 75 mm ƒ1.8 (shot at ƒ2.8)

photos.alt: A photo of a carrion crow sitting on top of a tree, on a fully leafless dead end of a branch at the very top. The branches below are also still leafless, but with some not yet sprouted leaf buds visible. Most of the frame is taken by the clear blue sky.
